stem: How do the phrases “reinforced the original intent” and “banned indefinitely” in paragraph 5 contribute to the tone of the paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: They create a formal, administrative tone.

options.label: B
options.text: They create a sly, ironic tone.

options.label: C
options.text: They create a sincere, persuasive tone.

options.label: D
options.text: They create a bitter, dejected tone.
